'''FC Samgurali''' ''([[Georgian language|Georgian]]'': საფეხბურთო კლუბი სამგურალი) is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[association football]] club from [[Tskaltubo]], which takes part in the [[Erovnuli Liga]], the first tier of [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian football]].

They have been runners-up of the [[Georgian Cup]] three times."}}
